description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ViewMultieditTest' for testing the 'ViewMultiedit' class, which is part of the SuiteCRM project. It includes test methods that instantiate the class, verify inheritance, and check the output of the display method with various conditions.

classes.name: ViewMultieditTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the ViewMultiedit class, testing its instantiation, inheritance, and display output.

methods.name: testViewMultiedit
methods.description: Tests instantiation of ViewMultiedit and verifies inheritance from SugarView, and checks that the type attribute is 'edit'.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method of ViewMultiedit with different scenarios: no request data, with action and module set, and with module list in request. Checks for correct output length.
